problem.title: Debate Tournament Standings with Win-Draw-Loss Scoring
problem.prompt: A community forum hosts monthly debate tournaments where two members face off in each debate. Each debate is recorded as one row with both participants: the `initiator_id` and `responder_id`, along with their upvote counts (`initiator_upvotes` and `responder_upvotes`). A member wins if their upvotes exceed the opponent's, draws if upvotes are equal, and loses otherwise. Award 3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 for a loss. Compute a leaderboard showing each member's total points, total debates participated, wins, draws, and losses. Include all members from the members table even if they have zero debates, showing 0 for all metrics. Return columns: `member_name`, `total_points`, `debates_played`, `wins`, `draws`, `losses`. Order by `total_points` DESC, then `member_name` ASC.
problem.schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE members (member_id INT PRIMARY KEY, member_name VARCHAR(100)); CREATE TABLE debates (debate_id INT PRIMARY KEY, initiator_id INT, responder_id INT, initiator_upvotes INT, responder_upvotes INT, debate_date DATE);
problem.example_input_data: INSERT INTO members (member_id, member_name) VALUES (1, 'Alice'), (2, 'Bob'), (3, 'Carol'), (4, 'Dave'); INSERT INTO debates (debate_id, initiator_id, responder_id, initiator_upvotes, responder_upvotes, debate_date) VALUES (1, 1, 2, 15, 10, '2024-01-05'), (2, 2, 3, 12, 12, '2024-01-08'), (3, 1, 3, 8, 14, '2024-01-12'), (4, 3, 1, 20, 18, '2024-01-15'), (5, 2, 1, 9, 9, '2024-01-20');

composite_moves: unpivot two-sided debate rows into per-member rows via UNION ALL (initiator branch + responder branch)
compute per-debate result (win/draw/loss points) using CASE on own_upvotes vs opp_upvotes
GROUP BY member_id to aggregate total_points, COUNT debates, SUM wins/draws/losses
LEFT JOIN members dimension to include members with zero debates
COALESCE aggregates to 0 for members with no debates

hints: Each debate row contains two participants. You need to treat each participant symmetrically, considering both their own upvotes and their opponent's upvotes.

Use UNION ALL to split each debate into two rows: one for the initiator (with initiator_upvotes as own, responder_upvotes as opponent) and one for the responder (reversed). Then compute win/draw/loss for each row based on comparing own vs opponent upvotes.

After splitting with UNION ALL, use a CASE expression to assign points (3 for win when own > opp, 1 for draw when own = opp, 0 for loss). Then GROUP BY member and SUM the points. LEFT JOIN from the members table to include members with zero debates, using COALESCE to turn NULLs into 0.
problem.answer_key:
WITH debate_sides AS (
  SELECT 
    initiator_id AS member_id,
    initiator_upvotes AS own_upvotes,
    responder_upvotes AS opp_upvotes
  FROM debates
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    responder_id AS member_id,
    responder_upvotes AS own_upvotes,
    initiator_upvotes AS opp_upvotes
  FROM debates
),
scored AS (
  SELECT 
    member_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN own_upvotes > opp_upvotes THEN 3
      WHEN own_upvotes = opp_upvotes THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS points,
    CASE WHEN own_upvotes > opp_upvotes THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win,
    CASE WHEN own_upvotes = opp_upvotes THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS draw,
    CASE WHEN own_upvotes < opp_upvotes THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS loss
  FROM debate_sides
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    member_id,
    SUM(points) AS total_points,
    COUNT(*) AS debates_played,
    SUM(win) AS wins,
    SUM(draw) AS draws,
    SUM(loss) AS losses
  FROM scored
  GROUP BY member_id
)
SELECT 
  m.member_name,
  COALESCE(a.total_points, 0)::TEXT AS total_points,
  COALESCE(a.debates_played, 0)::TEXT AS debates_played,
  COALESCE(a.wins, 0)::TEXT AS wins,
  COALESCE(a.draws, 0)::TEXT AS draws,
  COALESCE(a.losses, 0)::TEXT AS losses
FROM members m
LEFT JOIN aggregated a ON m.member_id = a.member_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(a.total_points, 0) DESC, m.member_name ASC;

_meta.scenario: a community forum tracking thread participation and member retention

user_solution:
/* notes */
WITH base AS (
SELECT
    initiator_id AS member_id,
    debate_id,
    CASE WHEN initiator_upvotes > responder_upvotes THEN 3
         WHEN initiator_upvotes = responder_upvotes THEN 1
         WHEN initiator_upvotes < responder_upvotes THEN 0
         END AS points
FROM debates

UNION ALL

SELECT
    responder_id AS member_id,
    debate_id,
    CASE WHEN initiator_upvotes < responder_upvotes THEN 3
         WHEN initiator_upvotes = responder_upvotes THEN 1
         WHEN initiator_upvotes > responder_upvotes THEN 0
         END AS points
FROM debates
)
SELECT
    m.member_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(b.points),0) AS total_points,
    COALESCE(COUNT(b.*), 0) AS debates_played,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.points = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS wins,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.points = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS draws,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.points = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS losses
FROM members AS m
LEFT JOIN base AS b
USING(member_id)
GROUP BY member_name
ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(b.points),0) DESC, m.member_name;
